description: This file defines the 'Row' class within the Drupal migrate module, representing a data row with source and destination properties, ID mapping, and utility methods for migration processing.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Represents a data row in Drupal's migration system, managing source data, destination data, ID mappings, and row state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Row object with source values, source IDs, and stub status, validating source IDs.

methods.name: getSourceIdValues
methods.description: Returns the values of the source identifiers in order.

methods.name: hasSourceProperty
methods.description: Checks if a source property exists.

methods.name: getSourceProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific source property value.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns all source properties.

methods.name: setSourceProperty
methods.description: Sets a source property value if the row is not frozen.

methods.name: freezeSource
methods.description: Freezes the source, preventing further modifications.

methods.name: cloneWithoutDestination
methods.description: Clones the row with an empty destination, preserving source data.

methods.name: hasDestinationProperty
methods.description: Checks if a destination property exists.

methods.name: setDestinationProperty
methods.description: Sets a destination property value.

methods.name: removeDestinationProperty
methods.description: Removes a destination property.

methods.name: setEmptyDestinationProperty
methods.description: Marks a destination property as empty.

methods.name: getEmptyDestinationProperties
methods.description: Returns all empty destination properties.

methods.name: hasEmptyDestinationProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property is marked as an empty destination.

methods.name: removeEmptyDestinationProperty
methods.description: Removes a property from the empty destination list.

methods.name: getDestination
methods.description: Returns the destination data array.

methods.name: getRawDestination
methods.description: Returns the raw destination data array.

methods.name: getDestinationProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific destination property value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value, source or destination, based on prefix '@'.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple properties, handling '@' prefix for destination properties.

methods.name: setIdMap
methods.description: Sets the ID mapping array.

methods.name: getIdMap
methods.description: Retrieves the ID mapping array.

methods.name: rehash
methods.description: Recalculates the hash for the row based on source data.

methods.name: changed
methods.description: Checks if the row has changed since last hash calculation.

methods.name: needsUpdate
methods.description: Indicates if the row requires an update.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Returns the current hash of the source data.

methods.name: isStub
methods.description: Returns whether the row is a stub.
